anchor.prompt: A photorealistic cinematic optical-illusion patisserie inside a refined operating bakery: a monumental ivory buttercream cake rises from polished black marble into impossible Escher-stacked tiers, an anamorphic rose-gold icing ribbon scatters across the room yet resolves as one perfect loop from this camera, a macro stainless piping tip reads like a graceful architectural monument, restrained frozen mirror-glaze droplets hover above the cake, and one blank edible-print sheet peels upward into a tiny luminous bakery scene without people. Deep teal glass shadows and rose-gold highlights, volumetric rear bakery light through fine flour dust, rich protected blacks, realistic buttercream pores, edible-paper fibres, polished marble veining, 40 mm large-format lens, subtle depth of field, restrained cinematic film grain. Premium patisserie, precise and inviting, never dark or sinister. Keep all indispensable forms inside the center half of the frame. No readable text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, logos, watermarks, captions, faces, people, hands, gore, body horror, dirty kitchen, cellar, clinic, melted objects, or unintended horror. 16:9 landscape composition.
